# Proposed CHILD-RUN: ordinary child evolution followed by running creator

This separate current-source family contains fully connected Archive, reattached
Notebook and Transfer documents. **Proposed; independent review pending, human
adoption and V3 runtime approval absent.** It extends the approved FORK-HIST input
without rewriting that input or RUN-HIST. Nothing here admits inhabited production,
actor capture, forecasts, diplomacy, abandonment or the whole game.

## Commands and proof strength

From repository root:

```
python3 docs/superpowers/specs/fixtures/living-v3-current-proposed/history/child-running/derive.py generate
python3 docs/superpowers/specs/fixtures/living-v3-current-proposed/history/child-running/derive.py verify
```

`generate` writes generated outputs; never hand-edit them. `verify` freshly
reconstructs them, compares exact bytes and evaluates every declared case using
the selected-family checker. An independently spelled second pass uses literal
byte domains and inline widths to reconstruct Genesis/root/fork/issuance,
Revision/source-State, final State/Receipt/Event frames. It does not call the
first framing helpers. It is formula crosschecking, not an independent reviewer.

There are **19 complete positive documents**, **26 rejection-only portable
mutations** and **8 private construction-trace failures**. All portable negative
expected results intentionally omit decoder stage/error/path priority. They
exercise running source/tick/parent/ordinal/mode/branch, exact reviewed before,
allocator regression, original fork binding, sibling future, selected-State
and Bookmark linkage, common ordinal duplicate, old Notebook attachment and a
fake fork Receipt Anchor. These known contradictions reject; they do not establish
multi-fault precedence. Re-sealing outer documents exposes semantic defects rather
than merely testing stale outer integrity.

The selected-family checker compares source-reconstructed exact normative records,
with genuine earlier selected views and legal dominating high-water marks. It
is **not** a general recursively closed wire decoder. Different shape-valid
metadata, larger histories, additional commands, other Catalog/Genesis profiles,
experiments/evidence and richer shapes are unsupported coverage, not automatically
invalid wire. The ledger lists those omissions explicitly. No generic parser,
capacity/collision scanner, bounded polling, cancelled job or producer implementation
claim is made. A constructor trace mutation is not a malformed portable document.
